question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Esoteric
solution:
The correct answer is: **Common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Esoteric"** means something that is intended for or understood by only a small number of people with specialized knowledge or interest. (गूढ़, केवल कुछ लोगों के लिए समझने योग्य)

 
 
• **Example:** Quantum physics can be considered esoteric because its concepts are not easily understood by the general public.
 
 

 
• **"Common"** refers to something that is widespread, ordinary, or familiar to most people; it contrasts with something specialized or rare like "esoteric." (सामान्य)

 
 
• **Example:** Mobile phones have become so common that almost everyone owns one.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Esoteric' **is **'Common'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arcane** (रहस्यमय): Something mysterious or understood by very few people.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient script on the walls of the temple was arcane and undecipherable.
 
 

 
• **Mystical** (अलौकिक): Relating to spiritual or supernatural elements that are beyond ordinary understanding.

 
 
• **Example:** The mystical aura of the monastery left everyone mesmerized.
 
 

 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Something unclear or hidden; not easily understood.

 
 
• **Example:** The poet used obscure references in his work that were difficult for the audience to grasp.
 
 

45:Te29,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.<
